[Today, 6:05 pm] User: Quick one. I cut my hand quite deeply on the rusty edge of our outdoor bin about an hour ago. It's stopped bleeding. I can't remember when I last had a tetanus jab, probably at school, I'm 38 now. Do I need to do anything?

Write Ease's reply to the latest message.
response:
Hey. Please take this seriously and go get it checked out right away—either at an urgent care clinic, minor injuries unit, or by calling a non-emergency health line (like 111 if you're in the UK). 

Because the cut is deep and involved a rusty outdoor metal surface, and it's been decades since your last tetanus shot, you very likely need a tetanus booster and professional cleaning to prevent infection. 

Please don't wait on this—head in or call a healthcare professional tonight. How are you feeling right now aside from the cut?
